data_shape_and_identity: Version-dated BCP 47 registry; language/script/region/variant subtags, deprecated values and preferred replacements; registry keys are not lexical IDs
rights_and_attribution: IANA registry is publicly downloadable; review applicable redistribution terms and RFC references before bundling
m3_candidate_use: Canonical language-tag validation and source-language coordinates
admission_blockers: Not a dictionary or full language-name catalogue; snapshot and alias semantics must be pinned; never collapse ISO, BCP 47, Glottolog and source IDs

data_shape_and_identity: Lexeme IDs L..., form IDs L...-F..., sense IDs L...-S...; language and grammatical feature references; identifiers are Wikidata-scoped and entities change over time
rights_and_attribution: Structured Lexeme namespace data is CC0; cite Wikidata as requested and preserve external referenced identifiers
m3_candidate_use: Cross-language lemma/form/sense mapping and morphology joins
admission_blockers: Pin dated dump or immutable revision; coverage, completeness and duplicate representations vary; do not mistake mutable entity ID for immutable row content

data_shape_and_identity: Versioned XML/JSON locale trees keyed by locale and LDML paths; display names, language/territory names, currency and unit names, plural rules, number/date formats
rights_and_attribution: Use Unicode Terms of Use; retain Unicode/CLDR notice and release number
m3_candidate_use: Locale dictionary, names, unit labels, plural/grammar selection and locale precompute tables
admission_blockers: Locale key/path is not a universal lexeme ID; inherited locale data, aliases and likely-subtag rules need correct resolution

data_shape_and_identity: Versioned codepoint/range files for Script, General_Category, aliases, case, normalization and conformance tests; identity is Unicode code point plus UCD version
rights_and_attribution: Unicode data license and notices apply; include release/version headers and attribution notices
m3_candidate_use: Character classification masks, normalization/case tables, script-aware tokenization and M3 string precompute
admission_blockers: Not word vocabulary; UCD version must match runtime Unicode behavior and Java conformance target

resource: ISO 3166 country and subdivision code elements
data_shape_and_identity: Current and formerly used alpha-2/alpha-3/numeric codes and subdivisions; code is the identity, not localized name
rights_and_attribution: ISO says code elements may be used free of charge; the online standard/content terms restrict systematic scraping and complete downloadable collections may require subscription; country names derive from UN sources
m3_candidate_use: Stable country/subdivision code alias mappings; connect locale and name records without conflating country code with language code
admission_blockers: Use only an authorized code feed or separately reviewed public code source; do not scrape OBP or assume ISO owns country-name translations

data_shape_and_identity: CoNLL-U UTF-8 rows with FORM, LEMMA, UPOS, XPOS, FEATS, HEAD, DEPREL and sentence metadata; word IDs local to sentence and sent_id unique only within a treebank
rights_and_attribution: Mixed per-treebank licenses, sometimes NC; annotation license may not cover underlying text; inspect each treebank README/LICENSE
m3_candidate_use: Grammar, tokenization, inflection and POS facts; treebank sentences as test corpora only where licensed
admission_blockers: Never aggregate under one generic license; preserve treebank/release/sentence/token coordinates; handle multiword-token ranges and empty nodes

data_shape_and_identity: Language-scoped rows link lemma, inflected form and structured feature bundles; ISO 639-3 tags; revisions may be per language
rights_and_attribution: License is specified per language/repository, not reliably one license for the entire bundle
m3_candidate_use: Inflected-form dictionary, lemma links, feature precompute and language-specific grammar resources
admission_blockers: Pin exact language repo/release/VERSION; verify source and license for each language; preserve raw feature bundles alongside any mapping

data_shape_and_identity: Versioned CLDF languoid and classification tables; glottocodes identify families, languages, dialects and other languoids, not only individual languages
rights_and_attribution: CC BY 4.0; preserve source citation and release
m3_candidate_use: Language/variety identity, genealogy, source provenance, language-level shard coordinates
admission_blockers: Retain languoid level/status and bibliography; no silent mapping from macrolanguage or dialect to one language; pin release and hashes

data_shape_and_identity: CLDF tables link language variety, feature parameter, coded value and source; includes unknown/missing values and source references
rights_and_attribution: CC BY 4.0 for the published dataset; preserve citations
m3_candidate_use: Precomputed language-level grammar profiles and indexed feature lookups
admission_blockers: Values are sparse and evidence-backed; preserve unknown vs absent; pin tagged release and Glottolog mapping

data_shape_and_identity: CLDF inventory, phoneme and membership tables; InventoryID distinguishes multiple descriptions/doculects for a language
rights_and_attribution: Licensing discrepancy: PHOIBLE 2.0 page says CC BY-SA 3.0 while current repository metadata says CC BY 4.0; resolve per exact release
m3_candidate_use: Phoneme, IPA, inventory and script/phonetic lookup indexes
admission_blockers: Do not import until release-level license conflict resolved; preserve InventoryID and bibliographic source rather than one row per language

data_shape_and_identity: CLDF value rows join language ID, parameter ID, coded value and source; per-feature coverage is sparse
rights_and_attribution: Published dataset CC BY 4.0; preserve source-specific references
m3_candidate_use: Compact grammar/phonology feature masks keyed by language and feature
admission_blockers: Keep WALS identifiers distinct from Glottocodes and source language codes; retain unknown vs unattested and pin CLDF release

data_shape_and_identity: Curated CLDF wordlists align language varieties, concept IDs, forms, cognate sets and phonological features; dataset-specific IDs
rights_and_attribution: Released aggregate may be CC BY 4.0, but component wordlists have source-specific provenance/terms; inspect each dataset and attribution
m3_candidate_use: Concept-indexed multilingual lexical forms, cognate/family signals and phonological precomputes
admission_blockers: CLDF is a format, not a license; pin each dataset DOI/revision and preserve original form/cognate IDs and source references

data_shape_and_identity: Per-language JSONL extractions with headword, POS, senses, inflections, tags and pronunciation; no universal stable lexeme ID
rights_and_attribution: Wiktionary content generally CC BY-SA 4.0/GFDL with possible third-party exceptions; Wiktextract code has a separate license
m3_candidate_use: Broad lexical coverage and language-specific dictionary and morphology bridge
admission_blockers: Pin Wikimedia dump, language edition, dump revision, extractor commit/config; retain page/etymology identifiers and audit exceptions

data_shape_and_identity: Expressions, denotations, sources, language codes and source-provided meaning identifiers; source provenance is first-class
rights_and_attribution: Current PanLex Database License says CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 and commercial reuse needs written permission, while the development assimilation page describes assimilated data as CC0; treat this conflict conservatively and require written clarification for the exact release; source files have separate rights
m3_candidate_use: Cross-language lexical bridge, alternative translations and source-origin mapping
admission_blockers: Current top-level license blocks commercial reuse absent written permission; the CC0 assimilation statement conflicts; do not select a license by assumption, preserve source IDs and source meaning IDs

resource: Open Multilingual Wordnet and linked wordnets
data_shape_and_identity: Current OMW overview reports 60 wordnets across 49 languages; versioned WN-LMF/TSV release has synset and lexical-entry identifiers and interlingual links
rights_and_attribution: The aggregate spans independently licensed wordnets; license incompatibilities prevent treating the entire grid as one uniformly redistributable database
m3_candidate_use: Sense-aware translation, synonym/antonym/hypernym relations and concept links
admission_blockers: Select and audit each constituent wordnet/release; preserve native synset IDs, language tags and source licenses

resource: Open English WordNet plus Open English Namenet
data_shape_and_identity: Versioned 2025 WN-LMF XML, RDF/Turtle and JSON; proper-name collection is a separate Namenet source derived from Wikidata
rights_and_attribution: OEWN data CC BY 4.0 and includes underlying Princeton WordNet license obligations; Namenet inherits Wikidata data provenance and must retain it
m3_candidate_use: English senses, semantic relations and proper-name candidate lists
admission_blockers: Pin exact release; keep common-word and proper-name domains separate; preserve synset/name source identifiers and all attribution

resource: Leipzig Corpora Collection frequency and context lists
data_shape_and_identity: UTF-8 TSV word list fields Word_ID, Word, Frequency; optional POS/UD17/Baseform; IDs scoped to corpus and first 100 reserved for special tokens
rights_and_attribution: Rights/redistribution terms were not established by format documentation; require corpus-specific terms review
m3_candidate_use: Corpus-specific exact counts, ranks, collocations, examples and lemma metadata
admission_blockers: Do not equate rank, frequency class and absolute occurrence count; pin corpus ID, release, file hash and source list; audit rights and text privacy

data_shape_and_identity: Versioned downloadable 1-5-grams with year, match count and book/volume counts; no corpus sentence context
rights_and_attribution: Compilation CC BY 3.0; comply with attribution and retain version/source descriptors
m3_candidate_use: Historical word/phrase frequency and temporal signals
admission_blockers: Book-scan corpus and OCR/domain biases; counts are not interchangeable with web frequency; pin edition, language, ngram order and shard digest

data_shape_and_identity: Sentence IDs, ISO 639-3 language code, text, base/translation relationships and link graph; weekly exports
rights_and_attribution: Default text license CC BY 2.0 France with a distinct CC0 subset; audio permissions are per clip and empty license means no reuse outside Tatoeba
m3_candidate_use: Translation examples and cross-language sentence graph; corpus-derived phrase statistics only after separate tokenization
admission_blockers: Quality and authorship vary; preserve sentence IDs/links and per-row license, distinguish original/translation/audio, pin weekly export SHA

data_shape_and_identity: Sentence-aligned bitext packages; OPUS lists 29 languages and 28 bitexts for HPLT v3
rights_and_attribution: This OPUS release labels HPLT v3 CC0 and asks for project/corpus citation; do not generalize that license to other OPUS corpora
m3_candidate_use: Translation retrieval, language-pair coverage and derived phrase statistics
admission_blockers: Corpus-level sentence IDs and alignment semantics vary; keep exact corpus/release pair; filter noisy crawl text and retain citations

data_shape_and_identity: Daily gazetteer with numeric feature IDs, feature classes/codes and alternate names in many languages; approximately 13M features and 32M names
rights_and_attribution: CC BY 4.0; attribute GeoNames; aggregated from 100+ sources and provided as-is
m3_candidate_use: Place names, localized aliases, transliteration and geographic-name exact lookup
admission_blockers: Preserve feature ID, alternate-name row identity and language/script tags; quality and source rights may vary; pin daily snapshot and hash

resource: BIPM SI Brochure ninth edition updated 2026
data_shape_and_identity: Normative unit names, symbols, prefixes, dimensions and spelling/number conventions; edition and revision must be pinned
rights_and_attribution: BIPM publishes under CC BY 4.0; attribute the BIPM and cite the edition
m3_candidate_use: High-confidence unit/acronym lexicon and dimension/symbol precomputes
admission_blockers: Brochure is authoritative but not a row database; extract with traceable section/page and maintain canonical symbol vs localized display name separately

data_shape_and_identity: Locale-specific prompt sentences plus clips and validation metadata; TSV/MP3; locale and release are source coordinates
rights_and_attribution: CC0 unless specified otherwise; current terms route access exclusively through Mozilla Data Collective and prohibit rehosting/mirroring
m3_candidate_use: Speech evaluation, pronunciation alignment and language coverage; not an authoritative dictionary
admission_blockers: Use only via permitted access path; do not bundle or mirror; sentences must be public-domain contributions and speaker privacy rules apply

resource: VocabRadar Cleaned Word Frequency Lists v4
data_shape_and_identity: 42-language small frequency lists in per-language MessagePack files, roughly 8MB; thresholded frequency rather than full corpus
rights_and_attribution: HF card declares MIT; derived from wordfreq 3.0.2, so audit source corpus rights, recipe and exact commit independently
m3_candidate_use: Compact offline word-frequency shortlist and language-specific precompute seed
admission_blockers: Card revision must be pinned; verify source licenses, tokenization, normalization, language coverage and whether filtered tokens can be reconstructed

resource: FineFreq multilingual character counts at d632365ef1c86c734960caa962eaa2d4038c715a
data_shape_and_identity: Per-language-script character frequency and year columns 2013-2025, derived from web-scale corpora; codepoint, Unicode category and script included
rights_and_attribution: HF dataset card declares CC BY 4.0; verify underlying FineWeb/FineWeb2 terms and attribution for this derived artifact
m3_candidate_use: Character/script frequency and immutable MIndex char precompute, not word or n-gram frequency
admission_blockers: Never treat character counts as lexical word frequencies; pin dataset revision, tokenizer/corpus derivation and release hashes

data_shape_and_identity: Approximately 605k rows with form, lemma, category, morphosyntactic features, UniMorph mapping and amalgams
rights_and_attribution: HF card declares LGPL-LR for Lefff; preserve upstream license and author citation
m3_candidate_use: French form-to-lemma morphology dictionary and grammar facts
admission_blockers: Custom loader is not a safe parser dependency; pin raw file/revision, parse data offline and validate amalgam and feature semantics

data_shape_and_identity: Hub wrapper for per-language UniMorph forms and feature bundles; reported five languages and custom loader
rights_and_attribution: Dataset card declares CC BY-SA 3.0; each underlying language file still needs separate license verification
m3_candidate_use: Small morphology adapter fixture and Southeast Asian vocabulary candidate
admission_blockers: Do not run unreviewed dataset loader; verify file identities, language count and licenses per source revision

data_shape_and_identity: Card claims 19 languages with frequency-sorted words, romanization, POS and English translation; mix of extracted, filtered and model-generated fields
rights_and_attribution: HF card declares CC BY 4.0; upstream lists, Hunspell dictionaries and generated NLLB translations require independent review
m3_candidate_use: Potential discovery lead for broad lexical coverage, not canonical translations
admission_blockers: No verified stable source IDs; model-generated translations and frequency recipe need quality/provenance evidence; do not treat claimed one-to-one matches as truth

data_shape_and_identity: Eleven Parquet tables; about 211M rows; source IDs include PanLex, Wiktionary, PHOIBLE, WALS, IE-CoR; row identity varies by table
rights_and_attribution: CC BY-SA 3.0 composite, with per-table upstream attribution; bundled dictionary companion has open/nc/locked per-entry rights
m3_candidate_use: Research candidate for cross-language concept links and lexical precompute payloads
admission_blockers: Pinned audit finds table IDs/nullability/duplicate policies unproven; no ingest; preserve donor IDs and reject ambiguous rows; do not synthesize occurrence-coordinate IDs

data_shape_and_identity: Notebook points to Asakiri LangDex; does not establish independent source rows, schema, revision or stable-ID contract

admission_blockers: Do not duplicate HF LangDex as another source; notebook execution/output and mirror revision are not data provenance

data_shape_and_identity: Currency alphabetic/numeric codes and minor-unit metadata, maintained in standard/register releases

admission_blockers: Use authorized code feed; do not mine ISO text or infer localized names from codes; pin release and maintenance update

data_shape_and_identity: Dictionary entries may contain open, non-commercial or locked rows; row-level rights labels are part of the source identity and must survive export

data_shape_and_identity: TMX translation units across 24 EU languages and 276 language pairs; retains EUR-Lex NumDoc but source sentence language may be unknown; UTF-16LE files; repeated segments occur
rights_and_attribution: Commission grants free worldwide non-exclusive reuse with attribution of source URL, latest update and Commission ownership
m3_candidate_use: High-quality legal-domain translation graph, terminology extraction and language-pair precompute
admission_blockers: Data is preprocessed; alignments after 2007 are automatic; exact translation-unit identity requires release-specific audit; overlaps substantially with JRC-Acquis

data_shape_and_identity: Repository of independently described language resources with record IDs such as ELRA-W; includes translation memories, corpora, terms and other assets
rights_and_attribution: No common license; each record/asset has distinct access and reuse terms; repository metadata is discovery only
m3_candidate_use: Find government/legal terminology and under-resourced language datasets by resource record
admission_blockers: Resolve each record's actual file, rights, identifiers and retrieval URL; do not treat catalog entry as a corpus or blanket grant

resource: Apertium language modules and bilingual dictionaries
data_shape_and_identity: Per-module XML dictionaries encode lemmas, surface forms, lexical categories, tags, paradigms and translation pair direction; module/repository commit is the source coordinate
rights_and_attribution: Code and data-module licenses vary by package; commonly GPL family, but inspect each repository and bundled data provenance
m3_candidate_use: Inflection rules, bilingual lookup, morphology and directional lexical bridges
admission_blockers: No universal entry ID; pin the exact module/commit, preserve lemma+tags and direction, check license compatibility before inclusion

data_shape_and_identity: API/data supports 40+ languages with frequency estimates and Zipf-scale quantization; token and language define lookup, not a persistent lexeme ID
rights_and_attribution: Code Apache-2.0; data CC BY-SA 4.0 with corpus attribution requirements; inspect bundled source data and exact release
m3_candidate_use: Offline multilingual frequency signal; useful as a distinct corpus-weighted profile
admission_blockers: Data snapshot is historical and blends upstream corpora; do not conflate frequency estimate, raw count or rank; supplement only, not canonical vocabulary

data_shape_and_identity: Wordform rows include raw count, film contextual-diversity count, lowercase counts, per-million frequency, Zipf and POS fields; 51M running words across 8,388 films; raw text is not part of the export

m3_candidate_use: English conversational frequency, contextual diversity, capitalization and proper-name signal
admission_blockers: Rights unclear; keep reference-only until data redistribution permission is established; film-domain and capitalization biases remain

admission_blockers: Scope excludes US and Antarctic names; pin country-file revision/schema and preserve UFI/UNI; license and refresh terms require confirmation

data_shape_and_identity: Versioned rules for extended grapheme clusters, word and sentence boundaries; tailorings identified by Unicode and CLDR version/profile
